verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting and on-call/incident workflows run continuously in the background, evaluating rules and triggering escalations/notifications without manual intervention (grafana-docs-1, grafana-gh-7, grafana-docs-19), which is a form of autonomous background automation. However, this is traditional rule-based alerting, not AI-agent-driven automation that an 'AI-native' user would configure; evidence of Grafana Assistant/Agent Observability (grafana-docs-45) shows AI features but no documented capability for users to set up autonomous AI agents/automations running independently in the background. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-driven or agentic automation setup (not just static alert rules), scheduling/triggering of autonomous agent tasks, and independent confirmation of such automations running unattended.
